original: शृणु मैत्रेय कलिना प्राप्ते कालेन दारुणे । हीयते सत्यशौचादि धर्मो नश्यति सत्वरम् ॥
transliteration: śṛṇu maitreya kalinā prāpte kālena dāruṇe | hīyate satyaśaucādi dharmo naśyati satvaram ||
translation: Listen, Maitreya, when the dark age of Kali arrives, truth, purity, compassion, and charity will rapidly decline among humanity.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.1): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: वित्तमेव कुलीनानां लिङ्गं शीलविवर्जितम् । बलं च धर्महेतुः स्यात्कलावस्मिन्महामुने ॥
transliteration: vittameva kulīnānāṃ liṅgaṃ śīlavivarjitam | balaṃ ca dharmahetuḥ syātkalāvasminmahāmune ||
translation: In Kali Yuga, wealth alone becomes the sign of nobility regardless of character, and brute force passes for righteous authority.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.2): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: यत्कृते दशभिर्वर्षैस्त्रेतायां हायनेन तु । द्वापरे तच्च मासेन त्वहोरात्रेण तत्कलौ ॥
transliteration: yatkṛte daśabhirvarṣaistretāyāṃ hāyanena tu | dvāpare tacca māsena tvahorātreṇa tatkalau ||
translation: That spiritual fruit which in Krita Yuga took ten years of austerity, in Treta one year, and in Dvapara one month—that is attained in Kali in a single day and night through remembrance of Hari.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.3): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: ध्यायन्कृते यजन् यज्ञैस्त्रेतायां द्वापरेऽर्चयन् । यदाप्नोति तदाप्नोति कलौ संकीर्त्य केशवम् ॥
transliteration: dhyāyankṛte yajan yajñaistretāyāṃ dvāpare'rcayan | yadāpnoti tadāpnoti kalau saṃkīrtya keśavam ||
translation: What was obtained in Krita by meditation, in Treta by sacrifices, and in Dvapara by temple worship, is obtained in Kali by the simple singing of Kesava's holy name.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.4): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: कलिः साधुः कलिः साधुः धन्याः शूद्राः सुखाश्रयाः । यदल्पेनैव यत्नेन प्राप्यते परमां गतिम् ॥
transliteration: kaliḥ sādhuḥ kaliḥ sādhuḥ dhanyāḥ śūdrāḥ sukhāśrayāḥ | yadalpenaiva yatnena prāpyate paramāṃ gatim ||
translation: Blessed is Kali Yuga! For in this age, with minimal effort and single-hearted love, humanity easily attains the supreme spiritual destination.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.5): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: चतुर्विधः प्रलयो ज्ञेयो नैमित्तिकः प्राकृतस्तथा । आत्यन्तिको नित्यश्चेति महाप्रलयलक्षणम् ॥
transliteration: caturvidhaḥ pralayo jñeyo naimittikaḥ prākṛtastathā | ātyantiko nityaśceti mahāpralayalakṣaṇam ||
translation: Fourfold is cosmic dissolution: periodic (Naimittika), elemental (Prakrita), absolute spiritual liberation (Atyantika), and perpetual change (Nitya).
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.6): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

original: संसारचक्रे भ्रमतो जन्तूनां कर्मबन्धनैः । दुःखत्रयाभिभूतानां विष्णुरेव परं पदम् ॥
transliteration: saṃsāracakre bhramato jantūnāṃ karmabandhanaiḥ | duḥkhatrayābhibhūtānāṃ viṣṇureva paraṃ padam ||
translation: For beings wandering on the wheel of Samsara bound by karma and scorched by the triple miseries, Lord Vishnu alone is the supreme refuge.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.7): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: तमेव सततं ध्यायेत्सर्वकर्मसमर्पणैः । न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिर्विष्णुलोकात्कदाचन ॥
transliteration: tameva satataṃ dhyāyetsarvakarmasamarpaṇaiḥ | na tasya punarāvṛttirviṣṇulokāt kadācana ||
translation: Medidate upon Him continuously, surrendering all actions unto Him; the soul that enters the divine realm of Vishnu never returns to mortal bondage.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.8): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: यथा नद्यः स्यन्दमानाः समुद्रेऽस्तं गच्छन्ति नामरूपे विहाय । तथा विद्वान्पुण्यपापे विधूय निरञ्जनः परममुपैति दिव्यम् ॥
transliteration: yathā nadyaḥ syandamānāḥ samudre'staṃ gacchanti nāmarūpe vihāya | tathā vidvān puṇyapāpe vidhūya nirañjanaḥ paramupaiti divyam ||
translation: Even as flowing rivers merge into the ocean, casting aside individual name and form, so the enlightened seer, purified of all karma, merges into the supreme luminous Godhead.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.9): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: विष्णुपुराण अंश 6 का यह श्लोक धर्म, भक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का स्पष्ट निरूपण करता है।

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.

original: य इदं पठते नित्यं विष्णुपुराणमनुत्तमम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो याति विष्णोः परं पदम् ॥
transliteration: ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ viṣṇupurāṇamanuttamam | sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||
translation: Whoever regularly studies this incomparable Vishnu Purana is delivered from all suffering and attains the eternal, supreme abode of Lord Vishnu.
meaning: Shastha Amsa — Kali Yuga Prophecy & Supreme Kaivalya (Verse 6.10): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson provides classical critical analysis of this verse from Vishnu Purana Book 6, highlighting its alignment with traditional Vedantic principles.

layers.content: श्रीधर स्वामींच्या आत्मप्रकाश टीकेनुसार हा श्लोक ईश्वरी कृपेने मुक्ती मिळवण्याचा मार्ग दाखवतो.
